messages:
sam_oncall: Quick handoff — wrapping up day shift. Main points: 1) postmortem remediation PRs #482 and #487 merged to canary, deployment started. 2) KV-cache TTL tweak rolled to canary only (watch perf). 3) Known risk: model fallback path still not exercised end-to-end; canary traffic is 5%. I'm logging checks below.

alex_dev: Thanks — noted. I'll run the canary verification script and smoke the fallback path before I step out. :thumbsup:

mariar: FYI — #487 fixes the race in shard assignment but we still need the DB index backfill from infra ticket INF-201. That backfill is scheduled tomorrow morning, not done yet. If it fails we should be ready to revert.

sam_oncall: Good call. Plan: if backfill doesn't complete by 10:30 PDT, revert #487 from canary and escalate. I'll annotate the canary runbook.

dave_se: Leaving a note — I'll trigger a canary failover test in staging then mirror to canary. If fallback isn't hit, we should simulate KV expiry to force fallback.

ci-bot: deployment: canary:ri-runtime:v3.14 -> started by @sam_oncall at 1912349999

monitoring-bot: alert cleared: high-llm-latency-prod (was firing on 1912348000), last seen 1912349700

alex_dev: Ran smoke checks. Short log snippet: ```
# curl -sS -X POST https://canary.redwood.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'
{"status":"ok","model":"rtd-24b-quant","route":"canary"}
```
Everything responds. Now exercising fallback: sending crafted request to exhaust KV hit.

alex_dev: Fallback exercised: observed model-switch to rtd-13b-quant on token 1, route changed as expected. Logs attached (pasted). :eyes:

mariar: Re: INF-201 backfill — I checked infra queue, job depends on PG vacuum slot that might be delayed. I've flagged infra for priority. If it slips we should update the incident tracker to avoid surprises for night shift.

sam_oncall: Noted. I'll add a line in the handoff doc and set the revert window. Also: quick checklist for next oncall — 1) watch for DB backfill start 2) verify no new 5xx spikes after canary -> prod scheduled 3) confirm rollout probes for fallback path.

dave_se: If we need to revert, commands below: ```
# revert canary rollout
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/ri-runtime --to-revision=124
```

alex_dev: One more: PR #490 (observability) is pending review and adds trace spans for fallback. Would be great to merge before prod. I can prioritize review tonight.

sam_oncall: Awesome. Tagging @mariar and @dave_se in the handoff doc. If anyone sees anomalous latency, ping with `!oncall` in this channel. Signing off — leaving notes in the handoff doc link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/handoffs/1912349999 — thanks team. :wave:
